where: Nightreach Lumenary (Nessa Cole's haunted hall) + the Nightreach inn and homes
mood: The Haunted Lumenary: the loneliest room in Vesperholm - a minor lullaby that reaches up and never quite comes home, a clock running down; hope present but not yet earned.
core_styles: A minor that never fully resolves
thin isolated pulse-wave lead with a lonely sad line trailing into long rests
slow minor music-box arpeggio with suspended chords
low sparse synth bass with long silences
unsteady clockwork tick like a clock running down
haunted, melancholy, intimate night-temple interior theme

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a hushed interior: an uneven clock tick in an empty room, a slow minor music-box figure, a held suspended chord that never lands}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the haunted melody in A minor: it reaches up with a rising leap and settles on a suspension instead of home, then trails into rest; sparse bass}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a soft celesta echo a beat behind it, like the room remembering, pad a little fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a moment of warmth in F major and C major, as if a lamp is lit in the dark room, the lead singing gently, then slipping back to a dissonant suspension}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the haunted melody returns, unresolved; the last bar hangs on a suspension that leads straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
